rules.title: A thesis for the doctoral degree must constitute original scholarship and must be a distinct contribution to knowledge

groups.title: Required Courses
groups.note: Students choose either BIOC 696D1/D2 or BIOC 696N1/N2. Students fast-tracking from the M.Sc. to the Ph.D. program, and who registered for and passed BIOC 696 at the M.Sc. level, do not register for BIOC 696 at the Ph.D. level. Likewise, students fast-tracking from the M.Sc. to the Ph.D. program, and who registered for and passed BIOC 610 and 611 at the M.Sc. level, do not register for BIOC 610 and 611 at the Ph.D. level. NOTE: Students DO NOT register for these courses until notified by the Student Affairs Officer.
